title: GitHub Copilot Workspace just made junior devs obsolete

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: GitHub Copilot Workspace replaces junior devs by automating code, eroding learning and growth in the development community. (3 sec)

lines.speaker: Vector
lines.text: Copilot accelerates development with real-time suggestions, reducing errors and allowing juniors to focus on logic, not syntax. (5 sec)

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: GitHub's vast repository and collaborative tools provide juniors with mentorship, feedback, and real-world project experience. (5 sec)

lines.speaker: Vector
lines.text: Copilot integrates seamlessly with VS Code and GitHub, offering context-aware completions that outperform traditional learning curves. (5 sec)

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: Copilot isn't a replacement—it's a tool that empowers juniors to build faster, learn more, and innovate smarter. (4 sec)
